t: 劳里亚的罗杰指挥阿拉贡斯分舰队,击败了一支被派去镇压马耳他叛乱的昂热文分舰队.
te: Roger of Lauria, commanding the Aragonese fleet, defeats an Angevin fleet sent to put down a rebellion on Malta.
dz: 劳里亚的罗杰指挥阿拉贡斯分舰队,击败了一支被派去镇压马耳他叛乱的昂热文分舰队.
de: Roger of Lauria, commanding the Aragonese fleet, defeats an Angevin fleet sent to put down a rebellion on Malta.

t: 威尔士最后一位本土亲王Dafydd ap Gruffudd被英格兰人绞死,取出并被收留.
te: Dafydd ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, is hanged, drawn and quartered by the English.
dz: 威尔士最后一位本土亲王Dafydd ap Gruffudd被英格兰人绞死,取出并被收留.
de: Dafydd ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, is hanged, drawn and quartered by the English.
